# Source: A Procession Scene with Musicians, from a copy of the Padshanama

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** A Procession Scene with Musicians, from a copy of the Padshanama
- **Artist / culture:** India
- **Date:** c. 1650
- **Style:** South Asian
- **Classification:** miniature painting
- **Department:** Arts of Asia
- **AIC artwork ID:** 49336
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/49336
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/c0a4ca33-c855-b1d3-c3dc-2eefb580377a/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Mughal Painting

## Extracted source palette

`#988868, #886858, #989888, #F8F8D8, #E8D8B8, #B8A898, #685848, #B89878`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#47362E`
- `surface`: `#5C4D46`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#B89878`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#F8F8D8`
- `surface_variant`: `#5C4D46`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#796C66`
- `error`: `#B89878`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `10.76:1`, surface `7.58:1`
- Variant contrast: `7.58:1`
- Control contrast: `7.26:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
